Ctrl+Left Click to instantly fill any bu: Ctrl+Left Click to instantly fill any buffer. Ctrl+Right Click to empty it.
Adds Keep Full and Keep Empty buttons to: Adds Keep Full and Keep Empty buttons to storage buildings. Keep Full continuously fills the storage. Keep Empty continuously drains it. Requires returning to main menu and reloading save to take effect.
Oil on the map never depletes (not world: Oil on the map never depletes (not world map/oil rigs).
Unlocks all research whose prerequisites: Unlocks all research whose prerequisites are already met. Techs locked behind unmet criteria are skipped. Does not touch repeatable research.
Unlocks every research node regardless o: Unlocks every research node regardless of criteria or prerequisites, in multiple passes until nothing remains. Does not touch repeatable research.
Settlement won't accumulate waste (landf: Settlement won't accumulate waste (landfill). No waste product is generated from housing.

Water facilities won't produce wastewate: Water facilities won't produce wastewater output. The building still works and satisfies housing water needs.

Research that normally requires accumula: Research that normally requires accumulating a quantity of a product (e.g. 200 spent fuel rods) unlocks without it. Research Unity and science costs are unaffected. Does not include World Map item requirements.
Research nodes unlock without their pare: Research nodes unlock without their parent technologies being researched first — pick and research anything in the tree directly. Research Unity and science costs are unaffected. Does not include World Map item requirements.
When ON, pipes follow sloped ground and: When ON, pipes follow sloped ground and ramp up and down hills instead of staying flat, so you can run a pipe straight down a hillside. Only affects pipes.
When ON, pipes can be built below the te: When ON, pipes can be built below the terrain surface. Press Down while placing a pipe to lower it past ground level. Only affects pipes.
When ON, a small number floats above eac: When ON, a small number floats above each buried pipe end while you are placing pipes, showing how many tiles deep below the surface it sits. Turn off to hide these depth numbers.
When OFF, the area-delete tool will skip: When OFF, the area-delete tool will skip pipes that sit below the terrain surface, protecting them from accidental bulldozing. When ON, area-delete behaves normally and includes underground pipes.
Show floating arrow icons above storages: Show floating arrow icons above storages that have Keep Full (green up) or Keep Empty (red down) active. Disable to hide the icons. Icon size can be changed via Tweaks++ → Modifications 2 → KE/KF Icon Size.
